title: Helion Energy stacking pillars
description: A centred uppercase heading over rows of a bracketed mono label with a short line, a 16:9 picture with 8px corners and a few small sentences. Phones stack each row centred. On desktop the heading sticks near the top and every row sticks mid-window so the next slides up over it: the covered picture shrinks to 92% and lifts while its words fade, and the new row's words fade up 20px.
notes: pure CSS: sticky rows plus view timelines on hidden sensor spans; desktop only (phones get a plain stack)
the desktop stack is about 3.1 windows tall (row spacing in svh); its fades are timed for a window around 900px and shift slightly on others
without scroll timelines or with reduced motion the rows still stack over each other, just without the fades and shrink
media is each row's photo or film; empty, a placeholder
name: helionenergy-pillars
